'''May 2000 San Jose tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Comics and Fantasies, San Jose, CA on 6 May 2000. It is known from Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d681">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-07-san-jose-ca-5-6-00d681/ san-jose-ca-5-6-00], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 7 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-07-san-jose-ca-5-6-00d681/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Comics and Fantasies, San Jose, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 11
